security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: A Discord alternative hosted by its members
bundle.longDescription: Kahui is an open-source, decentralised alternative to Discord. Communities are hosted by their members, not by a company: there is no central database, no login server, and nothing to sign up for.
